description: What Atoll's own view reads of the thread that asks it an operation, from /proc/<pid>/task/<pid>/status, when a check on a disk needs more than the account and group the kernel names: the filesystem's user and group ids, the fourth field of Uid and Gid; the other groups, Groups, in their order; and the effective capabilities, CapEff, a hexadecimal mask whose bit n is capability n. The watcher reads the same of the process behind an event, from /proc/<pid>/status, for its real account, the first field of Uid (uid), which a process changes only with CAP_SETUID, and which mergerfs keeps while a thread of its acts as its caller (§15.1). Uid, Gid, Groups and CapEff are required, each once; any other line is left as it is. A line it cannot read is an error.
